themes.title: Electoral Volatility and Internal Friction Facing Right-Wing Parties
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across several nations face electoral turbulence, internal party rifts, and governance challenges after entering power or preparing for upcoming midterms. In Sweden, the Sweden Democrats suffer poll slumps as mainstream parties adopt their policies, while internal controversies and regulatory friction challenge parties in France, the UK, Norway, and the US.

countries.note: Under investigation by the national electoral watchdog regarding campaign donation limits and financial transparency.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Navigating internal party friction over infrastructure policies and midterm electoral strategies.

themes.title: Challenges to Established Institutions and Norms
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders and movements are increasingly coming into direct conflict with press institutions, regulatory bodies, and legal norms. Unprecedented media bans from the US executive branch coincide with legal and financial scrutiny of major European populist parties.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Revoking White House press credentials for major news networks, sparking First Amendment press freedom debates.

countries.note: Facing demands from the European Parliament for expense repayments alongside ongoing legal eligibility rulings.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Subject to regulatory review over mega-donations from cryptocurrency figures.

themes.title: Trump's 'America First' Global Repercussions
themes.blurb: Unilateral US foreign policy initiatives, foreign defense sales, and international sanctions continue to reshape geopolitical alliances and create strategic dilemmas for foreign right-wing parties. Key US moves in Greenland, Saudi Arabia, and Russia ripple directly into European defense policy discussions.

themes.title: Immigration Policy and Enforcement Debates
themes.blurb: Border control, immigration enforcement, and demographic integration remain core ideological drivers for right-wing political agendas. Aggressive physical border construction in North America mirrors ongoing debates over cultural integration and policy adoption in Scandinavia.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Accelerating border wall construction in Texas while facing scrutiny over detention center human rights.

themes.title: Enduring Influence of Populist Personalities
themes.blurb: High-profile figureheads continue to anchor the identity, campaign strategy, and media visibility of major right-wing parties. Top leaders dominate public rallies and messaging, serving as both the principal driver of party momentum and the primary target for political opposition.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Donald Trump and JD Vance headline high-profile campaign rallies to dictate party direction and boost down-ballot candidates.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Jimmie Åkesson remains the central rallying figure for supporters and a key lightning rod for political opposition.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen maintains tight control over party positioning and future presidential campaign strategy.
